title: Holy Hour
summary: Intercept the departing worshipers before too many escape Thundercrest.
overview: Intercept the departing worshipers before too many escape Thundercrest.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Position along the departure route and intercept targets before they escape.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: A worshiper begins its departure route every four minutes and ten seconds.
Unengaged departing enemies can leave by the bridge and disappear.
The controller fails the task once the remaining enemies plus credited kills cannot satisfy the objective.
